notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for single and multiple object-instance name reservation, release, contention, and resignation cleanup. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, callback configuration, and federation identity. It verifies reservation callbacks, release and reuse, contention failure, multiple-name lifecycle, and cleanup without asserting provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador object-instance name reservation, release, federation membership, and disconnect declarations with FederateAmbassador reservation callbacks
